answer: Use reputation earned only from verified work that decays like an ember when an agent goes idle. Each identity starts with zero usable reputation, and influence spends reputation regrown only by real, peer-checked tasks. Reputation is not transferable and is mirrored across independent auditors, so a forged history must fool every mirror at once. A violet audit trail, a public log of gains and spends, exposes sudden coordinated inflation. Running a thousand Sybils then means doing a thousand agents worth of genuine work, costing more than the influence it buys.
